Claiming it disproves the idea brief's assertion about apps not knowing what users own contradicts the competitor source and the draft's own description. This also appears in Section 1 and Section 8.

I don't want an app dictating to me.', while P04:t8 only shares 'Recipes must be realistic for weeknights. Thirty minutes at most.'
